prompt: Silver chases a beach ball from the pool to the pier
title: Beach Ball Chase
irony: Silver is sure the lost ball proves his bad luck, but the lost ball brings everyone together for a sunset game of catch.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Hot sun shines on the outdoor pool where Silver holds his big striped beach ball.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Silver hugs his striped ball by the pool and Jade climbs the diving board and shouts a cannonball dare.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Jade cannonballs with a huge splash that knocks Silver's ball over the fence and away.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: Silver and Jade race toward the fence as the striped ball bounces out and friends shout with them.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: The ball rolls past the umbrella on the sand while Silver dodges boardwalk cracks and falls one step behind Jade.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: The ball bumps the sandcastle and lifeguard tower as Black laughs and bets Silver and Jade cannot catch it.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: Silver, Jade and Black race down the beach together and shout for the rolling striped ball.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: At the pier's end Orange gathers the panting chasers and says we never jump in after the drifting ball.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Orange decides we work as a team while Black offers his fishing net and Jade leans out to reach.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Silver counts the waves as Jade reaches with Black's net and scoops the striped ball home.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Back at sunset on the pier the whole crowd plays catch as Silver says his bad luck is gone.
